header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
body: None is present on behalf of the petitioner nor any intimation is received. This petition was filed in the year 2022. Since then no efforts have been made by the counsel for the petitioner to get the matter fixed before the Court or to proceed with it. Today position remains same. It appears that counsel for the petitioner has lost interest to pursue with the matter. Accordingly, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution. JUDGE JUDGE *Chander Kumar*
